group.passage: Zippers are everywhere today, on jackets, bags, and boots. Yet when an early form of the zipper was first shown to the public in 1893, almost nobody noticed it. The invention was slow to catch on: about thirty years passed before many people began to use it. The story began with Whitcomb Judson of Chicago, who was tired of lacing up his boots. In 1893 he invented a "clasp locker," a fastener for shoes that was opened and closed with a slide, and he showed it at the World's Fair in Chicago that year. However, most visitors paid no attention to it, and the device also had serious problems. It often got stuck, it could suddenly pop open when it was pulled hard, and its sharp parts could tear cloth, so it sold poorly. Help came from Gideon Sundback, a Swedish-born engineer who joined Judson's company in 1906. In 1913 he redesigned the fastener into a simpler and far more reliable form, and his most important change was to get rid of the hooks. In 1917, a tailor in New York used the new fastener to make money belts. These were the first products made with it in large numbers, and they were popular with sailors during World War I. After the war, it also began to appear on gloves and tobacco pouches. The biggest push came in 1923, when the Goodrich company began selling rubber boots with the new fastener. The company called it a "zipper," and the name stuck. By the late 1920s, zippers could be found on all kinds of clothes, shoes, and bags, and by the mid-1930s, even fashion designers were using them. Sadly, Judson never saw this success, because he died in 1909, years before anyone used the word "zipper." His business partner, Lewis Walker, was luckier. Walker spent about 20 years and around one million dollars on the fastener before it finally began to sell well.

translation_zh.text:
今天拉鍊到處都是，夾克、包包和靴子上都有。然而，1893 年拉鍊的早期形式第一次公開展示時，幾乎沒有人注意到它。這項發明很久才流行起來：過了大約三十年，才有很多人開始使用它。
故事從芝加哥的惠特科姆‧賈德森開始，他厭倦了綁靴子的鞋帶。1893 年，他發明了「扣環鎖」，一種用滑片打開、關上的鞋子扣件，並在同一年的芝加哥世界博覽會上展示。然而，大多數參觀者都沒有注意它，而且這個裝置還有嚴重的問題：它常常卡住，用力拉時可能突然彈開，尖銳的零件還可能把布料扯破，所以賣得很差。
幫手是 1906 年加入賈德森公司、出生於瑞典的工程師吉迪恩‧桑巴克。1913 年，他把扣件重新設計成更簡單、可靠得多的樣子，最重要的改變是拿掉了鉤子。1917 年，紐約的一位裁縫用這種新扣件做錢帶。這是第一種大量生產、用到這種扣件的產品，在第一次世界大戰期間很受水手歡迎。戰後，這種扣件也開始出現在手套和菸草袋上。
最大的推力出現在 1923 年：Goodrich 公司開始販賣裝有這種新扣件的橡膠靴。公司叫它 zipper，這個名字就流傳下來。到了 1920 年代末，各式各樣的衣服、鞋子和包包上都找得到拉鍊；到了 1930 年代中期，連時裝設計師也開始使用。
可惜賈德森沒有看到這份成功，因為他在 1909 年就過世了，那是任何人使用 zipper 這個字的好幾年前。他的合夥人路易斯‧沃克比較幸運：沃克在這種扣件上花了大約 20 年和大約一百萬美元，它最後終於開始賣得好。
